note: lvl = his Level %ile at the position in that division. Per club: rank = his place among that club's players at the position (1 = first choice), slots = how many start there in the manager's preferred formation, line = Level %ile of the weakest of them (null = the club has no natural player for that slot, so he walks in). He starts iff rank <= slots. Ability is expressed as percentiles and division ranks only — the raw ability number never leaves the machine that built this.
